title: Voucher Extent

Vouchers.description: Whether the response should contain main information about vouchers.

VoucherCodes.description: Whether the response should contain voucher codes used by customers.

VoucherAssignments.description: Whether the response should contain assignments between vouchers and Rates.

Companies.description: Whether the response should contain detail of related companies.

Rates.description: Whether the response should contain detail of assigned rates.

description: Extent of data to be returned. Whether only specific voucher info should be returned or related items as well.
